name: Hero with Product Proof
purpose: Establish the product/category, value proposition, CTA, and product credibility in the first viewport.
compositionNotes: Use when the PRD has a clear product. Keep a hint of the next section visible.

name: Bento Feature Grid
purpose: Present 4-7 core capabilities through mixed-size cards.
compositionNotes: Use one dominant cell and avoid equal-card monotony.

name: Workflow Steps
purpose: Show how users move from input to outcome.
compositionNotes: Use after hero or feature grid when the product needs process clarity.

name: Product Screenshot Stage
purpose: Make the actual product UI the visual centerpiece.
compositionNotes: Use realistic UI details; do not use blurred atmospheric placeholders.

name: Logo Cloud Proof
purpose: Add trust signals through customer, partner, or integration logos.
compositionNotes: Keep compact; avoid making logos the page focus.

name: Metric Strip
purpose: Show quantified proof such as speed, cost, conversion, uptime, or usage.
compositionNotes: Place after proof/product sections; values should feel plausible.

name: Integration Wall
purpose: Show ecosystem breadth through integrations or connected tools.
compositionNotes: Use when PRD mentions tools, APIs, or ecosystem.

name: Comparison Table
purpose: Differentiate from legacy workflow or competitors.

name: Testimonial Wall
purpose: Add social proof through user quotes or review cards.
compositionNotes: Use varied card sizes; avoid too many long quotes.

name: Pricing Table
compositionNotes: Use only if PRD implies plans/pricing.

name: Security and Compliance Band
purpose: Handle trust objections for B2B products.

name: FAQ Accordion
compositionNotes: Place near bottom before final CTA.

name: Final CTA Band
compositionNotes: Avoid adding new concepts; summarize the page promise.
